marketNotes.text: Italy has enough sellers for its own price layer: direct shops plus 20+ shops on Trovaprezzi and Idealo list LTO-6 to LTO-10 media in EUR.
All recorded prices include 22% IVA. Senetic and Bechtle (B2B) show the net price first; the gross price shown below it was recorded.
Bechtle.com/it sells to business and public customers only.
Offers seen on Trovaprezzi or Idealo are tagged 'via Trovaprezzi' or 'via Idealo' in the seller name and link to the comparison page. Marketplace merchants are named after a colon.
eBay and OnBuy offers shown on Trovaprezzi and Idealo were not recorded; one listing per seller and part number was kept (the lowest).
LTO-10 40TB: only Bechtle lists a cartridge (Quantum MR-A10MQN-01, backorder). No Fujifilm 16978170 offer found in Italy.
No Italian seller listed an LTO-10 drive on 2026-09-23 (Bechtle, Senetic, Trovaprezzi, Idealo, ePRICE checked).
HPE Store Italy shows quote-only indicative prices excl. IVA: BC022A 6932.33, BC023A 6027.86, BC040A 10985.15, BC042A 11160.02 EUR. Not used as datapoints.
HPE P84140/1/2-B25 external drives are bundles with 5 cartridges. Quantum -FZ/-EZ drive-plus-HBA bundles, rackmount and library drive kits were skipped.

Trovaprezzi, Idealo and ePRICE refuse plain fetches (HTTP 403) and were read in a real browser. BPM Power, Monclick, Yeppon and Kaufland.it show bot checks; their offers appear here only via the comparison sites.
